Welcome to this journey—a moment where politics, personal ambition, and the very real emotions of loss and resilience all come together. Imagine standing at the crossroads of change, in a country searching for direction, and asking yourself, "What now?" That's exactly where Hillary Rodham Clinton found herself in the story woven through her book, What Happened.
Together, we’ll explore what it’s like to face setbacks head-on, to wrestle with expectations, and to balance personal conviction with the weight of public scrutiny. These aren’t just headlines—they’re deeply human experiences, filled with vulnerability, determination, and the kind of reflection that makes us all wonder how we move forward after a pivotal moment.
As we step into the highs and lows of a historic campaign, we’ll see how hope and disappointment, criticism and courage, all play their part in shaping what leadership really means. Along the way, we’ll get a closer look at the challenge of breaking barriers and the importance of staying true to what matters most—even when the world is watching.
So, let’s set out together and discover the lessons and insights that emerge when ambition meets adversity, and when the drive to keep going becomes a story worth sharing. Are you ready? Let’s explore what it truly means to move forward—one step at a time.
